（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 3261
Date 5 / 5 / 32）

Extract from Chinese Newspapers Translation
6.3.32.
--------
Suggested Boycott of Messrs. Honigsberg & Son
for supplying cars to the enemy.

The Chamber of Commerce has received the following
letter from the Bureau of Public Safety:-

Reports have reached this Bureau to the effect
that the firm Honigsberg and Son withdrew the cars
which it had sold to the Chinese on the installment basis
and given these same cars to the Japanese military
authorities. The majority of these cars are Studebaker
and their number is legion.

The Company has promised the Chinese purchasers
to give them new cars in exchange later on, but this is
mere talk. We hereby ask you to investigate this matter
with a view to boycotting this firm.

C. & S. B. 登记处。
编号 D 3261
日期 32年5月5日）

中文报纸译文摘录
32年3月6日。
--------
建议抵制 Honigsberg & Son 公司，因其向敌人供应汽车。

本商会收到公共安全局来函如下：-

据报至本局称，Honigsberg and Son 公司将此前以分期付款方式出售给中国人的汽车收回，并将这些相同的车辆交给日本军方当局。这些汽车多为司蒂倍克（Studebaker）牌，数量众多。

该公司曾承诺中国买家日后将提供新车作为交换，但这仅是空谈。特此请贵会调查此事，以便对该行号实施抵制。

Translation of an article contained in the "Lung Pao" (龍報)

Office : Vung Yuen Lee (丈元里), opposite Far
Eastern Hotel, Thibet Road.
Distribution Agency : Mr. Sung Dong (史桐), Kung La
Loong (孔家弄), Inside the Post Gate.
------------------------------------

A DEPLORABLE AFFAIR ON MEDHURST ROAD.

A large crowd of workers turn traitors.

Amongst them are some who can speak the English.

A certain Wong Su Chuin (王恕君) wrote us a letter
giving an account as follows of an affair to which he was
an eye-witness. Mr. Wong states as follows :-

While passing Honigsberg & Son on Medhurst Road today,
I saw five or six Japanese military officers. My curiosity
was at once aroused by their appearance there so I halted
to see what happened. My observation tells me that the
Japanese military officers were there to buy some trucks.
They bought four or five very old and worn out trucks. The
body of the trucks however was fairly large. Whilst I was
wondering as to the object of the Japanese military
officers in purchasing these trucks I suddenly saw several
tens of workers arriving on the scene. They spoke the
Northern dialect. There were also about 30 workers who
spoke the Southern dialect. These workers, under the
supervision of the Japanese military officers and the
foreigners of the Company, immediately started to repair the
old trucks. They were seen to be extraordinarily diligent
at work. A man looked like foreman was busy supervising the
work. His attitude to the Japanese military officers
was very respectful, and it seemed that he intended to
hurry up the work of repairing the trucks. A short time

上海公共租界工部局警务处
C. & S. D. 登记处
S. D. D. 3961
32年2月23日

译自32年2月20日出版的《龙报》（Lung Pao）第16号增刊中的一篇文章。

办事处：西藏路远东饭店对面，丈元里（Vung Yuen Lee）。
发行代理：史桐（Sung Dong）先生，老北门内孔家弄（Kung La Loong）。
---

麦赫斯特路上的一桩可悲事件。

大批工人沦为汉奸。

其中有些人会说英语。

一位名叫王恕君（Wong Su Chuin）的人士致信本报，叙述了他亲眼目睹的一件事。王先生陈述如下：-

今日途经麦赫斯特路的 Honigsberg & Son 公司时，我看见五六名日本军官。他们的出现立刻引起了我的好奇，于是我驻足观看发生了什么事。据我观察，日本军官是来购买卡车的。他们购买了四五辆非常陈旧且磨损严重的卡车。不过，这些卡车的车身相当大。正当我纳闷日本军官购买这些卡车的目的时，我突然看见数十名工人来到现场。他们讲北方方言。还有大约30名工人讲南方方言。这些工人在日本军官和公司外籍人员的监督下，立即开始修理旧卡车。只见他们工作格外勤奋。一名看似工头的人正忙着监督工作。他对日本军官的态度非常恭敬，似乎打算加快修理卡车的工作进度。不久

pages.en:
- 2 -

later the four or five old trucks had turned into
entirely new vehicles. The most strange thing is
that the foreman could speak the English language and
he is not a member of the illiterate class. I do not
understand why he willingly offered his services to the
enemies. Being an eye-witness to the affair I felt
very sad and so hurriedly went home. Will you please
publish a warning in your newspaper advising these
people not to be greedy for money/and offer themselves
to be utilized by the enemies.

The people of our country fail to hold the
same opinion ( ? lack unity) and this easily leads
to exploitation by our enemies. It is deplorable to
see a foreman, who can speak English, being utilized by
our enemies. This foreman must be a faithless and
beastly person.

8. Honigsberg & Son - Fitters and Mechanics - Strike

38 fitters and mechanics of Honigsberg & Son, 271
Medhurst Road, failed to turn up for duty on the morning
of February 21 as a protest against their employer supplying
motor trucks to the Japanese Consulate. They resumed
unconditionally this morning, February 24.

INTELLIGENCE
SUMMARY
24.2.32
pages.zh:
- 2 -

之后，那四五辆旧卡车就变成了全新的车辆。最奇怪的是，
那位工头会说英语，
他并非文盲阶层。我不
明白他为何甘愿为敌人
效力。作为此事的目击者，我感到
非常悲痛，于是匆匆回家。恳请
贵报刊登警告，劝诫这些人不要贪财，
任由敌人利用。

我国人民意见不一（？缺乏团结），这很容易导致
被敌人利用。看到一位
会说英语的工头被敌人利用，实在令人痛心。
这位工头必定是个背信弃义、
禽兽不如的人。

8. Honigsberg & Son 公司 - 装配工与机械师 - 罢工

Honigsberg & Son 公司（麦赫斯特路271号）的38名
装配工和机械师于2月21日上午未上班，以抗议
雇主向日本领事馆供应卡车。他们于今晨，即2月24日，
无条件复工。

情报
摘要
32年2月24日
